text:
maria (eng-runtime): Hey team — running seq-length sweep on H100/A100/L40S for the "fused-paged-flash-v2" kernel. Seeing a weird throughput dip at seq=4096 / batch=4 on H100 where KV cache eviction rate spikes. attaching quick logs.

jon (perf): Can you paste the microbench command + raw numbers? my guess is a threshold in the prefetch/batch heuristic is flipping.

maria (eng-runtime): Command:
```
./bench_attn --model gpt2 --kernel fused-paged-flash-v2 --gpu h100 --seq 4096 --batch 4 --kv-cache --prefetch=auto
```
Output excerpt:
```
throughput: 8.2k tokens/s (seq=2048,b=8)
throughput: 7.9k tokens/s (seq=3072,b=6)
throughput: 4.3k tokens/s (seq=4096,b=4)  <-- big drop
kv_evictions: 0% (<=3072) -> 12.6% (4096)
lat_p50: 34ms -> 76ms
```

ryan (ml): That eviction % is telling. Is the KV partitioning spilling pages to host memory or being rebalanced? Could be our KV cache allocator deciding to compact on a per-request boundary when estimated working set > slot limit.

kellie (infra): On H100 the driver pinned memory fragmentation is worse with our current CUDA malloc pool. We saw similar on another service where large contiguous allocations failed and fallback caused a page fault path. Can you repro with `NV_GPU_MEMPOOL_STATS=1`?

maria (eng-runtime): Re-ran with mempool stats and a smaller batching policy (max_batch=8 -> 6). Stats: page_faults=0 but mempool_fallbacks=3 at seq=4096. Also tried `--prefetch=off` and got throughput 5.1k tokens/s (improved but still lower than 2048 case).

jon (perf): So prefetch path adds pressure but disabling it reduces but doesn't eliminate regression. Could be kernel choice: we fallback from fused-paged-flash to a non-vectorized kernel at a certain token-per-thread threshold. Need profiling flamegraphs around attention kernel selection.

maria (eng-runtime): Attached short perf trace (link) and kernel names: `flash_paged_fp16`, `flash_variant_fused`, then at the spike we see `attention_fallback_slow` and much higher SM idle times.

perf-bot: Regression alert created: PERF-2026. Tags: h100, seq4096, fused-paged-flash-v2, kv-evict. Assigned to @jon @maria.

jon (perf): I'll bisect the kernel selector thresholds. Quick plan: 1) reproduce on H100 w/ minimal allocator (cudaMalloc) 2) run selector debug logging with `KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1` 3) sweep batch sizes around 2-8 to find flip point 4) try small quantized variant.

ryan (ml): Also try L40S - we've had different memory layouts there. If L40S doesn't show eviction it's likely allocator/driver interplay on H100.

maria (eng-runtime): Ran L40S seq=4096 b=4 -> throughput 6.9k tokens/s, no mempool_fallbacks. So H100-specific.

kellie (infra): I'll schedule a repro on a fresh H100 VM with driver 535 and then with 540 to rule out driver regression.

jon (perf): For next steps I'll push a debug build that logs the kernel selection weight/score. If we confirm an incorrect fallback we can tighten the thresholds or add a fallback backoff to avoid mid-request evictions.

maria (eng-runtime): Great. I'll paste the selector debug output when ready. For tracking: linking to PERF-2026 and the bench run ids: run-8891 (H100), run-8892 (L40S). Thanks.
